titulo_es: Describe a change of capacity or habit

よめる.es: poder leer; ser capaz de leer
よめる.en: be able to read; be able to read

bloques.titulo: In this case, the Commission is not in a position to make a decision on this matter.
texto: Potential verb +))) expressed acquired capacity; non-volitive verb +)) may describe a natural change. The context helps to distinguish them.
I have come to read Japanese newspapers.
(Now I get up early every morning.)
